stage: Stage A: asynchronous routing request to a published corporate route. No offer, no meeting ask, no problem claim.
demand_exposure_note: FS-001-A1 section 5: a routing attempt is a RoutingAttempt, not an OutreachExposure. Reaching the buyer upgrades the route and nothing else. Pain volunteered unprompted is SPONTANEOUS / NON_PREREGISTERED and counts toward no gate. A role inbox never counts as exposure or demand evidence (FS-001 ACCESS).

access.verified_access_account: a cohort account with at least one DIRECT or route-confirmed ROUTED path to the probable operational buyer (FS-001-A1 section 3)
access.failed_requires: routing actually attempted and resolved; before judge_not_before FAILED is reported as ROUTING_IN_PROGRESS

demand.pain_conversation_definition: a meeting booked or a proposal requested (fs001.py count_funnel)
demand.pass: at least 1 paid design partner, the only gate answering the premise
demand.kill: after 30 clean deliveries, any of: replies < 5, pain conversations < 3, proposals sent < 2

research_snapshot.command: theplus-growth fs001 in the imported copy, read-only
direct_access_companies: Will Stone Gas Plumbing and Heating Ltd
research_snapshot.note: Research state, not market outcomes. Re-take the snapshot if research changes named buyers or DIRECT paths; route confirmations come from approved replies at verdict time.

response_mapping.note: A routing reply is recorded through approved AUTHORITY_SIGNAL evidence (a referral, a named diary owner, 'wrong person'). A pain conversation is a meeting booked or an approved PROPOSAL_REQUESTED.

next_actions.no_human_replies: Stage B, as preregistered (FS-001-A1 section 6): live telephone routing for the accounts Stage A did not resolve, only through the outbound-contact compliance gate (TPS/CTPS screening with a named source, caller identification, displayed number, internal suppression, recorded prior objection). Do not build product. An ACCESS failure is a reachability decision: change channel, change the buyer, or conclude the ICP is not reachable at this cost. It is never evidence against demand (FS-001 'Kill criteria').
next_actions.routing_without_demand: Record each confirmed route as a verified-access account and continue toward the 15-account ACCESS gate. Ask demand only through a separate named-buyer exposure counted against 30 clean deliveries (FS-001 DEMAND).
next_actions.demand_without_meetings: Keep the demand evidence as SPONTANEOUS / NON_PREREGISTERED (FS-001-A1 section 5): it informs the named-buyer demand exposure and counts toward no gate.
next_actions.meetings_without_proposals: Outside Stage A's preregistered scope. A person decides, against the DEMAND gates (3 pain conversations, 2 proposals sent, 1 paid design partner over 30 clean deliveries).
next_actions.proposals_without_customers: Outside Stage A's preregistered scope. A person decides, against the DEMAND pass gate (1 paid design partner).
next_actions.customers: DEMAND PASS for this workflow: product work is unblocked for that one workflow only (fs001.py _demand).
